newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks rebound sharply, Nikkei above 18,000.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks rebound sharply, Nikkei above 18,000.

text.p: Tokyo stocks rebounded sharply in late Monday afternoon trade.
The key Nikkei average recaptured the psychologically important 18,000 yen level on what traders said was a technical recovery after Friday's plunge.
Short-covering, especially in banking sector shares, pushed up the index. But traders said the rally was a temporary rebound, rather than a clear reversal of the bearish stock market trend.
As of 0555 GMT, the benchmark Nikkei 225 average stood at 18,125.77, up 822.12 points or 4.75 percent.
